description: Find likely duplicates: same claimed sha1, or same size+mediaType without sha1 (candidates only). verify=true downloads and sha256s them ('verified'; writes temporary local files, removed afterwards). Reports wastedBytes and a suggested keeper; never deletes. Walk results are cached up to 5 min (refresh=true re-reads; first walk of a large drive can take minutes).

verify.description: Download and hash candidates of the top groups.

name: drive_find_duplicates
title: Find duplicate files
